aiTables.featureDescription: Models that AI text and AI choice fields can use.
aiTables.promptHelp: Sent to the model for every row. Insert fields to use the row's values.
aiTables.promptPlaceholder: Summarize the description in one sentence
aiTables.fileFieldHelp: The files in this field are sent to the model with the prompt.
aiTables.autoUpdateHelp: Runs as you. It stops if you lose access to the table.
aiTables.autoUpdateLabel: Regenerate when a field in the prompt changes
aiTables.optionsHelp: The model picks one of these for every row.
aiTables.transformDescription: The AI rewrites the text of each selected cell using your instruction, like "Fix the spelling" or "Write the name in Title Case". It can't answer questions about your data. Empty cells are skipped. You'll see every change and choose which to keep before anything is saved.
aiTables.transformCount: {count} cells will be sent to the model.
aiTables.transformTooMany: {count} cells are selected. At most {max} can be transformed at once, so select fewer rows or columns.
aiTables.transformNotEnabled: No AI model is enabled for AI fields in this workspace. Enable one in the AI providers settings, then try again.
aiTables.transformNotEnabledAskAdmin: No AI model is enabled for AI fields in this workspace. Ask a workspace admin to enable one in the workspace's AI providers settings.
aiTables.instructionHelp: Sent to the AI with each cell's text and its column name. Its answer is the cell's new text, which you review before it's saved.
aiTables.instructionPlaceholder: Write the name in Title Case
aiTables.transformStarted: When it's done, you'll see the changes to keep or reject. Nothing is saved before that.
aiTables.previewDescription: Untick a change to reject it. Only the ticked changes are saved, and you can undo them.
aiTables.previewFailed: The AI failed on {count} rows; their cells are left as they are.
aiTables.noChanges: The AI's answers were the same as the cells, so nothing was changed.
aiTables.applied: {count} cells were changed. Undo with Ctrl+Z.
aiTables.appliedSkipped: {count} cells were changed. {skipped} rows were edited since the AI ran, so their cells were left as they are.
